Watchtower report — the rendering contract for service state (glossary: Watchtower, Service). DRAFT 0.1 — built 2026-10-21 on HgX's order; awaiting ratification. Normative on ratification only.

confidence.description: Renderer confidence in the reading (Paper IV §6.6). A reading past fresh_until without downgraded confidence is a schema-era violation — downgrade, don't guess

evidence_ref.description: Evidence reference for the rendered state (Paper IV §6.6)

freshness.description: When the observation was taken (Paper IV App. C.3)

note.description: Only when state is not operational

state.description: Closed rendering enum. Operator-paused reads as paused, never down. Unknown is never rendered as operational (INV-S1). A 403 that prevents verification is 'unknown', not 'degraded'

title: WatchtowerReport
